focus: Adversarially trace every supported event: no last-event masking or correction waiver
Path-only log lookup uses source+.MOVED.json exactly and compares optional historical identity
Schema refusal paths return one path-qualified message and continue later JSONL rows
No implicit volume discovery, mutation, source presence requirement, resolver hashing or scoring
Fixture tests create local temporary bytes only; known equal-size corruption explicitly demonstrates metadata-only mode limitation
limitations: Directory/tree schemas deliberately unsupported; caller must account for excluded schemas in census denominator
Metadata-only mode cannot detect equal-size non-AppleDouble corruption; hash_payloads=True is the digest authority
Scanner does not follow subsequent MOVED chains, so relocation of certified destination remains a violation until original custody assertion is repaired
